step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates the backend infrastructure for Your Call Football, built on AWS. Mobile devices connect to two separate Application Load Balancers (ALBs) representing REST API and Voting traffic entry points. Both ALBs route incoming requests into an Amazon EKS cluster running Kubernetes microservices. The microservices feed voting and REST event data into an SQS queue, which is then processed asynchronously by background scoring and game microservices back in EKS. Session state is cached in ElastiCache to relieve database load, while persistent data is stored in Amazon Aurora.
